svg.title: Nested wave lines on paper, in five pictures. 1: one flowing lead line, drawn slowly in one smooth stroke. 2: a second line that follows the first at the same distance, like a lane next to it. 3: more lines nested the same way, each one copying the one before. 4: the lanes filled with color: purple, magenta, orange and yellow. Done: black lines painted again over the edges, and thin white highlight lines inside the bands.
